product: Adacel (Tetanus Toxoid, Reduced Diphtheria Toxoid and Acellular Pertussis Vaccine Adsorbed)

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: Adacel is a sterile isotonic injectable suspension of tetanus and diphtheria toxoids and pertussis antigens adsorbed on aluminum phosphate, for intramuscular use.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: Other ingredients per 0.5 mL dose include 1.5 mg aluminum phosphate (0.33 mg aluminum) as the adjuvant, ≤5 mcg residual formaldehyde, <50 ng residual glutaraldehyde and 3.3 mg (0.6% v/v) 2-phenoxyethanol (not as a preservative).

allergens.quote: Syringe, without needle, single-dose – NDC 49281-400-89 (not made with natural rubber latex);
Adacel does not contain a preservative.
1.5 mg aluminum phosphate (0.33 mg aluminum) as the adjuvant

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: A severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) after a previous dose of any tetanus toxoid, diphtheria toxoid or pertussis containing vaccine or any other component of this vaccine is a contraindication to administration of Adacel.

warnings.label: Latex
warnings.quote:
package of 5 vials; NDC 49281-400-05. The vial
stopper is not made with natural rubber latex.
